note: [L] has the same setup (nonnegative transfer kernel, normalized cyclic trace, a move by l changing the two adjacent gaps by +l and -l) in YM.TimeKernel.passage and YM.Slice.Time.powering. It estimates the move differently: YM.Holder.finite_lip extends the gap lengths to complex powers (Holder.leap) and applies a Hadamard-type bound (Holder.estimation). There is no rescaling to 0 <= T <= 1 and no factorization T^{n1}(T^l X - X T^l)T^{n2-l} through 1-T^l.

snippet.text:
theorem finite_lip {X : M ι} (h : X.PosSemidef) (b : Fin n → M ι) {N width p m : ℕ}
    (he : N=(p+p)*width) (hp : 0 < p) (hw : 0 < width) (hz : 0 < Q X N)
    {Y Z : Fin n → ℕ} (hY : n*width+∑ i, Y i=N)
    (i j : Fin n) (hij : i≠j) (hu : Y i+m=Z i) (hv : Z j+m=Y j)
    (hm : ∀ a : Fin n, a≠i → a≠j → Y a=Z a)
    (r : ℝ) (hr : 0<r) (hO : ∀ i : Fin n, 2*r < Y i) (hs : (m:ℝ) ≤ r) :
    ‖(combine (fun i => b i*X^Z i)).trace-(combine (fun i => b i*X^Y i)).trace‖ ≤ cost X b p N / r * m := by
  have hN : 0<N := by rw [he]; positivity
  have hJ : 0<Y i := Nat.cast_pos.mp (lt_of_le_of_lt (show 0≤2*r by positivity) (hO i))
  let W (x : ℂ) (s : Fin n) := ↑(Y s) + ((if s=i then x else 0) - (if s=j then x else 0))
  let F (x : ℂ) := total h b (W x)
  have hF : Differentiable ℂ F := by
    unfold F total; apply (dtrace (ι := ι)).comp
      (dproduct (fun x i => b i*leap h (W x i)) ?_)
    intro a
    exact (differentiable_const _).mul ((leap_smooth h).comp (show Differentiable ℂ (fun x => W x a) from by
      unfold W; split_ifs <;> fun_prop))
  have hh (x : ℂ) (hx : ‖x‖ ≤ 2*r) : ‖F x‖ ≤ cost X b p N := by
    refine estimation h hp hN ?_ ?_ hz
    · intro a
      have hl := hO a
      have ha := (abs_le.mp (abs_re_le_norm x)).1
      have hb := (abs_le.mp (abs_re_le_norm x)).2
      change 0 ≤ (W x a).re; unfold W
      split_ifs <;> simp only [Complex.add_re,Complex.natCast_re,Complex.sub_re,Complex.zero_re] <;> linarith
    have hy : ∑ i, W x i = ∑ i, (Y i:ℂ) := by simp [W, Finset.sum_add_distrib,Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    have hg : ∑ i, (W x i).re = ∑ i, (Y i:ℝ) := by simp only [← Complex.re_sum, hy]; simp
    rw [hg,rate]
    have hN' : (N:ℝ)>0 := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hN
    have hf : (0:ℝ)<p+p := by exact_mod_cast (show 0<p+p by omega)
    have hj : (n:ℝ)*width+∑ i, (Y i:ℝ)=(N:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hY
    have hy' : (N:ℝ)=(↑p+↑p)*(width:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast he
    rw [Nat.cast_add]
    calc
      _ = ((n:ℝ)*width+(∑ i, (Y i:ℝ)))/N := by field_simp; grind
      _ = _ := by rw [hj,div_self hN'.ne']

proof_context.conclusion: For a PSD matrix X and gap lists Y, Z differing by moving m sites between two gaps, the cyclic trace difference is at most cost/r * m, proved by complexifying the gap lengths (leap) and bounding the holomorphic function on a disc (estimation).

theorem passage (B : Fin n → K X) (h : NNKernel T) (hc : possible T) (ht : ∀ i, possible (B i)) {width N p m : ℕ}
    (he : N=(p+p)*width) (hp : 0 < p) (hw : 0 < width) (R : ℝ) (hr : 0 < R) (hR : closed μ (List.replicate N T) = ↑R)
    {Y Z : Fin n → ℕ} (hY : n*width+∑ i, Y i=N)
    (i j : Fin n) (hij : i≠j) (hu : Y i+m=Z i) (hv : Z j+m=Y j)
    (hm : ∀ a : Fin n, a≠i → a≠j → Y a=Z a)
    (r : ℝ) (hy : 0<r) (hO : ∀ i : Fin n, 2*r < Y i) (hs : (m:ℝ) ≤ r)
    (K : Fin n → ℝ) (hK : ∀ i, ‖closed μ (multiply (B i) p)‖^(Holder.rate p) ≤ K i * R ^ (Holder.rate p)) :
    ‖closed μ (along T B Z)-closed μ (along T B Y)‖ ≤ R*(∏ i, K i)/r * m := by
  letI : Nonempty (Fin n) := ⟨i⟩
  have hZ : 0<N := by rw [he]; positivity
  let P := Quad.shrink X
  have ha := learns μ (List.replicate N T) (by simp [hZ.ne']) fun i hi => (List.mem_replicate.mp hi).2 ▸ hc
  simp_rw [List.map_replicate, List.prod_replicate,hR] at ha
  have hl : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ => Holder.Q (sample μ (P x) T) N) atTop (𝓝 R) := by
    unfold Holder.Q; simpa only [Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_pos hr,P] using ha.norm
  let A (k : ℕ) (v : Fin n → ℕ) := (Holder.combine (fun i => sample μ (P k) (B i) * sample μ (P k) T ^ (v i : ℕ))).trace
  let D (k : ℕ) := Holder.cost (sample μ (P k) T) (fun i => sample μ (P k) (B i)) p N
  have hq : ∀ᶠ k : ℕ in atTop, ‖A k Z-A k Y‖ ≤ D k / r * m := (hl.eventually (lt_mem_nhds hr)).mono
    (fun x hx => Holder.finite_lip (safe μ _ _ h) _ he hp hw hx hY i j hij hu hv hm r hy hO hs)
  let f (i : Fin n) := ‖closed μ (multiply (B i) p)‖^(Holder.rate p)
  have h' : Tendsto D atTop (𝓝 ((∏ i, f i) * R ^ ((1:ℝ) - n*Holder.rate p))) :=
    (tendsto_finsetProd Finset.univ (fun i _ => totality μ _ (ht i) hp)).mul (hl.rpow_const (Or.inl hr.ne'))
  apply le_trans (le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto ((goes μ T hc _ ht Z).sub (goes μ T hc _ ht Y) |>.norm)
    ((h'.div_const _).mul_const _) hq)
  have hx := Finset.prod_le_prod (s := Finset.univ) (f := f) (fun i _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _)
    (fun i _ => hK i)
  let a := Holder.rate p
  refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right ?_ hy.le) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
  apply le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hx (Real.rpow_nonneg (x := R) hr.le (1 - n*a))) (le_of_eq ?_)
  rw [Finset.prod_mul_distrib,Finset.prod_const,Finset.card_univ, ← Real.rpow_mul_natCast hr.le,mul_assoc,← Real.rpow_add hr]
  rw [Fintype.card_fin,show Holder.rate p*↑n+(1-n*a) =1 by unfold a;ring]; simp [mul_comm]

proof_context.conclusion: Transfers the finite-matrix Lipschitz bound to the cyclic transfer-kernel integrals with partition value R: the closed correlation changes by at most R*(prod K)/r*m when two gaps change by +m and -m.

theorem powering (β : ℝ) (hβ : 0 ≤ β) (B : Fin m → Brick a G n) {p l w : ℕ}
    (he : n.val=(p+p)*w) (hp : 0 < p) (hw : 0 < w) (hW : ∀ i, (B i).width=w)
    {Y Z : Fin m → ℕ} (hY : m*w+∑ i, Y i=n.val) (hZ : m*w+∑ i, Z i=n.val)
    (i j : Fin m) (hij : i≠j) (hu : Y i+l=Z i) (hv : Z j+l=Y j)
    (hm : ∀ z : Fin m, z≠i → z≠j → Y z=Z z)
    (r : ℝ) (hy : 0<r) (hO : ∀ i : Fin m, 2*r < Y i) (hs : (l:ℝ) ≤ r)
    (b c : Per n) (H : Fin m → Per n) (K : Fin m → ℝ)
    (hK : ∀ x : Fin m, ‖moment β (word (column (B x) p) (H x))‖ ^ (Holder.rate p) ≤ K x) :
    ‖moment β (word (drive B Z) b) - moment β (word (drive B Y) c)‖ ≤ (∏ i, K i)/r*l := by
  have hi (v : Fin m → ℕ) (h : m*w+∑ i, v i=n.val) : duration (drive B v)=n.val := by
    simp_rw [drive_time,hW,Finset.sum_add_distrib]; simp [h]
  let f (x : Fin m) := (B x).pulse β
  let R := partition G n β
  have hr : 0<R := partition_pos _
  have hC x : ‖closed (trans n G a) (multiply (f x) p)‖^(Holder.rate p) ≤ K x * R ^ (Holder.rate p) := by
    unfold f; rw [← colony _ _ β, ← closed_eval _ _ (H x) (show duration (column _ _)=_ by rw [clockTime,hW]; exact he.symm)]
    rw [norm_mul,Real.mul_rpow (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _),mul_comm]
    rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_pos hr]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hK x) (Real.rpow_nonneg hr.le _)
  letI : @BorelSpace (Leaf G a n) (MetricSpace.toPseudoMetricSpace (α := Leaf G a n)).toUniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace _) := instBorelSpaceLeaf _
  letI : @SecondCountableTopology (Leaf G a n) (MetricSpace.toPseudoMetricSpace (α := Leaf G a n)).toUniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace := instSecondCountableTopologyLeaf _
  letI : @CompactSpace (Leaf G a n) (MetricSpace.toPseudoMetricSpace (α := Leaf G a n)).toUniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace := (inferInstance : CompactSpace (Leaf G a n))
  have hx := passage (trans n G a) _ f (step_positive a (n := n) hβ) (heat_cont ..) (fun i =>
    testB_cont β _ (B i).reads) he hp hw _ (partition_pos β (G := G) (n := n)) (partition_seen β) hY
    i j hij hu hv hm r hy hO hs K hC
  rw [← show cores (drive B Z) β = _ from B_start B Z β,← show cores (drive B Y) β = _ from B_start B Y β,
    ← closed_eval _ _ b (hi Z hZ),← closed_eval _ _ c (hi Y hY), ← mul_sub] at hx
  rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hr] at hx
  apply le_of_mul_le_mul_left _ hr
  apply hx.trans_eq
  ring

proof_context.conclusion: The normalized periodic moment with brick insertions changes by at most (prod K_i)/r*l when one insertion moves by l between two adjacent gaps.
